changes.text: Explorer: a new file or folder may be a path, a/b/c.txt - the missing folders on the way are made
Explorer: dragging with Ctrl held copies - into the same folder as "a copy.txt"
Explorer: the active editor's file is revealed in the tree - folders expanded, selected, scrolled to
Git history: a commit's context menu copies its whole message or its hash
State: state.toml is replaced whole under a lock between windows, a broken tail dropped on reading
Terminal: a mouse selection starts where the button went down, not a cell aside where the drag was recognized
State: values of another version's state.toml are dropped one by one, the recent folders and tabs kept
Title rows: a long title runs under the buttons, veiled there, in every view - not into them in a narrow panel
GitLab view: merge requests and issues, the branch's last pipeline with run / cancel / retry, job logs in the editor
Cleanup by clippy: the terminal unlocked before laying out its text, UTF-8 checked once on opening a file
